description: This file defines the 'nusoap_server' class, which implements a SOAP server capable of handling SOAP requests and generating SOAP responses, including WSDL support, method registration, and request processing.

classes.name: nusoap_server
classes.description: A class that implements a SOAP server, enabling registration of methods, handling of SOAP requests, and SOAP response serialization, with WSDL support.

classes.name: soap_server
classes.description: A backward compatibility class extending nusoap_server.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Processes incoming SOAP requests, handles WSDL requests, or provides web service descriptions based on the HTTP request method and query parameters.

methods.name: parse_http_headers
methods.description: Parses HTTP headers from the incoming request to extract headers, request method, encoding, and SOAPAction.

methods.name: parse_request
methods.description: Parses the SOAP request payload and sets relevant request fields, including method name, parameters, and headers.

methods.name: invoke_method
methods.description: Invokes the registered PHP function or class method corresponding to the SOAP request.

methods.name: serialize_return
methods.description: Serializes the method's return value into a SOAP response envelope.

methods.name: send_response
methods.description: Sends the SOAP response or fault back to the client, including HTTP headers and optional compression.

methods.name: verify_method
methods.description: Verifies if the requested operation exists in the WSDL or operation map.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses the SOAP message received from the client, setting method name, parameters, and headers.

methods.name: getHTTPBody
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response body; in this implementation, simply returns the provided SOAP message.

methods.name: getHTTPContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type for HTTP response, typically 'text/xml'.

methods.name: getHTTPContentTypeCharset
methods.description: Returns the charset for the response content type.

methods.name: add_to_map
methods.description: Deprecated method for adding operations to the dispatch map; replaced by register().

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a PHP function or class method as an SOAP operation, with details like input/output params, namespace, style, and use.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Sets up a SOAP fault to be returned to the client, marking that an error has occurred.

methods.name: configureWSDL
methods.description: Configures and generates a WSDL document for the web service.
